test_title: PYST 76: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

After a long journey I was looking forward to __sleep on a__ comfortable bed.
solution:
The correct answer is: **sleeping in a**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the original sentence, the phrase "**to sleep**" is an **infinitive**, which is not the most appropriate choice in this context.
 
• When **expressing anticipation or desire after a certain activity** (in this case, the long journey), it is more appropriate to use the **gerund form of the verb**.
 
• The corrected sentence uses "**sleeping**," which is the **gerund form**.
 
• The preposition "**in**" is used to indicate the location where the action (**sleeping**) takes place.
 
• The use of "**in**" suggests a sense of being surrounded by the comfort of the bed.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence**: *After a long journey I was looking forward to sleeping in a comfortable bed.*
